title.orig: An Act Declaring July Six of Every Year A Special Nonworking Public Holiday in the Municipality of Mambajao, Province of Camiguin, To Be Known As "Mambajao Charter Day"
title.th: วันก่อตั้งตามกฎบัตร Mambajao

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1997/ra_8252_1997.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: July six is the charter day anniversary of the Municipality of Mambajao, Province of Camiguin, and its celebration is highlighted with colorful parade, stage drama, and beauty pageant.
July six of every year is hereby declared a special nonworking public holiday in the Municipality of Mambajao.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, February 11, 1997.
